en-US.name: ghr
en-US.releaseNotes:
A toolkit for GitHub releases.
Highlights
- Shortened .tgz, .txz, and .tzst archive handling (#261): Centralized archive suffix detection and Wasm bundle suffix stripping across .tar.zst/.tzst, .tar.xz/.txz, .tar.gz/.tgz, and .zip as a single case-insensitive source of truth (preserving lowercase-only .wasm* rules), with deterministic tie-breaking when a release publishes both .tar.<ext> and .t<ext> variants.
- Official Zig 0.17.1 toolchain (#262): Upgraded ghr and the documentation site to official Zig 0.17.1 (cataggar/zig@v0.17.1) while preserving 0.16.0 and 0.17.0 toolchain selection for historical reproducible rebuilds.
- GitHub Actions and attestation documentation (#259, #263): Simplified doc/github-actions.md, documented fail-closed GitHub artifact attestation verification (attestations: read and skip-attestation), and updated examples to @v0.10.4.
Full changelog: v0.10.3...v0.10.4
Install
Linux and macOS:
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cataggar/ghr/main/install.sh | GHR_VERSION=v0.10.4 sh
Windows (PowerShell):
$env:GHR_VERSION = 'v0.10.4'; iwr -useb https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cataggar/ghr/main/install.ps1 | iex
See Installation for package managers and uninstall instructions.
